summary: Specifies the Neighbor Discovery protocol for IPv6, which lets hosts and routers find each other on a link and learn about nearby network details. It is on the standards track as a proposed standard. It was replaced by RFC 2461.

eli5.summary: When you move into a new neighborhood, you look around to see who lives next door and where the exits are. This is how computers do it.

questions: how do ipv6 hosts find neighbors
